decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1/ 	The proposal is considered an overdevelopment of the site  and unsuitable for occupation by a further separate person or household  and combined with a lack of amenity space and such use would have a detrimental effect upon the character of  the neighbourhood  and is contrary to the Policy H 3.4 (Conversion of premises to flats) of the Unitary Development Plan.
.
2/ 	The proposed creation of an additional flat in the roofspace by the construction of  two dormer roof extensions with an external spiral staircase  would, by reason of their size, position and appearance  in relation to  neighbouring residential properties, be unduly obtrusive, detrimental to the amenities of adjoining occupiers and the streetscene and is contrary to the Policies ENVB 1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance, Residential Extension Guidelines.     

3/  	The proposed intensification of use by the creation of an additional flat is likely to give rise to an unacceptable increase in associated noise disturbance and loss of privacy which is likely to be detrimental to the amenity of the surrounding residential properties and is contrary to the Policies  ENVB 1.1 (New Development) of the Unitary Development Plan.     

4/ 	The proposed creation of an additional flat in the roofspace by the construction of a two dormer roof extensions and external staircase would, by reason of their  size, position and appearance, not serve to enhance the character of the Spring Grove Conservation Area and is contrary to the Policy ENVB 2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the Unitary Development Plan.
description: Conversion of roof area to form additional self contained unit, erection of rear roof extension and external staircase to existing building
